payload.claim: _finish_verify's docstring says the verify callable is shared by finish.publish_finish and finish.judge_draft, 'each wrapping it to its own shape.' In fact only the publish_finish caller wraps it (cli.py's lambda converts the tuple to len()); the judge_draft caller (_stack_follow_ups's judge_verify) passes _finish_verify's return value straight through as verify=judge_verify with no wrapping at all, exactly as the spec's own acceptance text says ('returns the comparison's new_failures unchanged'). The docstring overstates what the judge path does.
